about: DATA-88 per-tenant archive_read token. token = hex(HMAC-SHA256(key = ARCHIVE_READ_MASTER's characters as set, not hex-decoded and not case-folded; message = 'archive_read:' + tenant_id)), tenant_id being the exact tenant UUID string the dashboard_host event carries (no case folding). sha256 = hex(SHA-256(the token's 64 lowercase hex characters)) and is what the control plane writes to the sandbox as AV_ARCHIVE_READ_HASH; the sandbox never holds the token or the master. Read by agentvillage overlay plugins/dashboard-auth-edgecity/tests/test_archive_token.py; agentvillage-data tests and the control plane's control-plane/tests copy these values verbatim (same precedent as telegram_identity.v1.json).
_comment: TEST keys only, never used anywhere else. master = hex(SHA-256(UTF-8 'agentvillage DATA-88 archive_read.v1 TEST master, never used anywhere else')); rotated master = hex(SHA-256(UTF-8 'agentvillage DATA-88 archive_read.v1 TEST master, never used anywhere else (rotated)')). Regenerate with python3: hashlib.sha256(seed.encode()).hexdigest(), then hmac.new(master.encode(), ('archive_read:' + tenant_id).encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(), then hashlib.sha256(token.encode()).hexdigest().

cases.note: tenant B, same master: a different token
tenant A after a master rotation: the old token no longer matches
the master's characters as set: an upper-cased master is a different key
the tenant id as carried: an upper-cased UUID is a different message
